votes.motion: Commissioner Squire moved to APPROVE the November 14, 2024, November 21, 2024, and December 12, 2024 Planning Commission Meeting Minutes as presented

Commissioner Squire moved to APPROVE the 13081 South Minuteman Drive Subdivision as requested by David Johnson of Johnson Engineering, representing Microflex 1 Springville for a Preliminary Plat, Application 2024-0328-SUB subject to the following: Findings for Approval: 1. The proposed subdivision complies with DCMC Section 17-3-040(A). 2. The proposed subdivision plat complies with the standards and criteria found in DCMC, including, but not limited to, the subdivision ordinance, the land use ordinance, the General Plan, Master Street Plan, and City standard specifications and design criteria

Commissioner Shirey moved to APPROVE the Deviation Request from strict compliance with the geographical restrictions for I-ADUs, as requested by Jayme Kogel and Jean Weatherwax, Application 2024-0427-VAR subject to the following: Findings for Approval: 1. The lot or parcel on which the primary dwelling is located is at least six thousand (6,000) square feet. 2. No D-ADU exists on the property. 3. The proposed I-ADU can meet all of the requirements of sections 9-31-030 and 9-31-045, including other applicable requirements of this chapter before issuance of an ADU permit
